name: nse-mcp-explorer
description: Interactive explorer, playground & beginner guide for the official NSE India MCP servers (Model Context Protocol) — live NSE quotes, 5-year Bhavcopy history, market breadth, analytics, AI agent demo. TypeScript + Python examples.

paragraphs: An open-source NSE MCP client, playground and tutorial for the National Stock Exchange of India's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — live NSE stock quotes, top gainers/losers, 5-year Bhavcopy price history, market breadth, corporate actions, analytics and an AI-agent demo, with TypeScript and Python examples for Claude, ChatGPT and your own apps.

Heard about NSE MCP but don't know where to start? This repository is an interactive playground and guide for the official NSE India MCP servers. In about ten minutes you can understand what MCP is, connect to NSE, run every tool it offers, inspect the raw protocol messages, and see what you can build with the data.
